The powdery, fuzzy gray-blue coating spreading across the fruit surface is the hallmark sign of whisker/blue mold on citrus.

The image clearly shows a fungal mold infection with blue-green powdery spore masses on a citrus fruit, which is definitively Whisker Mold.
